T: Say it three times. Then eat.
D: A recently dead couple hire an obnoxious ghost to scare the new owners out of their house.

Prawns poached in salted water for 2 minutes, iced, piled into glasses over shredded iceberg with a sauce of mayo, tomato sauce, horseradish, lemon and a dash of hot sauce.
Adam's model of Winter River in the attic
Cubes of cheddar, gouda and pepper jack stacked like tiny houses on a board, with cherry tomato and gherkin for the trees.
take a number in the afterlife

Seeded crispbreads spread with whipped lemon ricotta, topped with roast cherry tomatoes, basil and black pepper, each numbered with a dot of balsamic glaze. Roast 250g cherry tomatoes with 1 tbsp olive oil and salt at 200C for 15 minutes until they split. Beat 250g ricotta with the zest of 1 lemon, 2 tbsp olive oil and a pinch of salt until smooth. Spread onto 16 seeded crispbreads, top with the tomatoes, torn basil and cracked pepper. Pipe a small number on each with 2 tbsp balsamic glaze and hand them out in order.
M: Lobster tails split, brushed with garlic, lemon and parsley butter, grilled flesh side up under a hot grill for 6 minutes. Shoestring fries and a green salad.

Pork shoulder braised with chipotle, orange and cumin until it shreds, crisped in a hot pan and piled into corn tortillas with pineapple salsa and lime crema. Cut 1.2kg pork shoulder into large chunks and brown. Add 2 chipotles in adobo, the juice of 2 oranges, 1 tsp cumin, 1 onion, 3 garlic cloves and 250ml stock. Cover and cook at 160C for 3 hours, then shred and fry in a hot pan until crisp at the edges. Dice 250g pineapple with red onion, coriander and lime. Mix 150g sour cream with lime juice. Fill 12 warm corn tortillas with pork, salsa and crema.
W: black and white stripes, like the suit
Vanilla and chocolate sponge batters piped in alternating stripes into a loaf tin, baked at 170C for 50 minutes, covered in white chocolate ganache with dark chocolate stripes.
K: Blend 45ml white rum, 20ml lime juice, 15ml sugar syrup and half a ripe banana with a cup of ice until smooth.

dishes.make_ahead: Sauce up to 2 days, prawns poached up to 1 day ahead

steps.text: Poach the prawns in salted simmering water for 2 minutes until just cooked.
Chill in iced water, then drain well.
Mix the mayonnaise, tomato sauce, horseradish, lemon and hot sauce.
Shred half the lettuce into four glasses, pile in the prawns and spoon the sauce over.

dishes.make_ahead: Up to 4 hours ahead, covered in the fridge

steps.text: Cut the three cheeses into cubes.
Stack the cubes into tiny houses on a long board.
Thread the tomatoes and cornichons onto toothpicks as trees and stand them between the houses, like Adam's model town.
Split the lobster tails lengthways. Mash the butter with the garlic, lemon zest and parsley and brush over the flesh.
Cut the potatoes into shoestrings, rinse and dry well.
Fry the potatoes in batches at 180C until crisp, drain and salt.
Grill the lobster flesh side up until just opaque.
Dress the salad leaves in lemon juice and serve with the lobster and fries.
Beat the butter and sugar until pale, add the eggs one at a time and fold in the flour and milk.
Stir the cocoa into half the batter.
Pipe or spoon alternating stripes into a lined loaf tin.
Bake at 170C until a skewer comes out clean.
Cool the cake in the tin (included in cook time).
Melt the white chocolate with the cream and pour over the cake. Pipe stripes with the melted dark chocolate.
Dissolve the sugar in the hot water.
Cool the syrup for 10 minutes.
Blend the rum, lime juice, syrup, bananas and ice until smooth and pour into chilled glasses.

dishes.make_ahead: Sauce up to 2 days, prawns poached up to 1 day ahead

steps.text: Pat the prawns dry and chill.
Mix the mayonnaise, tomato sauce, horseradish and lemon juice into a lively sauce.
Pile the lettuce into bowls, top with the prawns and spoon over the sauce.
Serve cold and keep your face clear of the bowl.
Cut the pastry into long strips and brush with egg.
Press white sesame onto half the strips and black sesame onto the rest, with a little salt.
Twist each strip into a spiral and lay on lined trays.
Chill the twists for 15 minutes (included in cook time).
Bake at 200C until crisp and golden.

dishes.make_ahead: Up to 4 hours ahead, covered in the fridge

steps.text: Cut the cheeses into cubes.
Stack into small houses on a board.
Thread tomatoes and cornichons on toothpicks as trees and set between the houses.
Split the lobster tails and brush with the garlic and parsley butter.
Cut the potatoes into shoestrings, rinse and dry, then fry in batches at 180C until crisp and salt.
Grill the lobster flesh side up until just opaque.
Dress the salad leaves with lemon juice and serve with the lobster and fries.
Beat the butter and sugar until pale, add the eggs and vanilla, then fold in the flour and milk.
Stir the cocoa into half the batter and layer or swirl both batters in a lined 20cm tin.
Bake at 170C until a skewer comes out clean.
Cool completely in the tin (included in cook time).
Melt the white chocolate with the cream, cool slightly and pour over for the ganache.

dishes.make_ahead: Meringues up to 3 days ahead, assemble on the day

steps.text: Whisk the egg whites to soft peaks, add the sugar a spoonful at a time until stiff and glossy, then fold in the vinegar.
Pipe tall spires onto lined trays.
Bake at 110C until crisp, then leave to dry in the switched-off oven (included in cook time).
Crush half the blackberries with icing sugar for the swirl and whip the cream.
Build the sculpture with meringue spires, cream and blackberry swirl, finishing with whole berries.
Press the lemons for juice.
Heat the sugar with the water until dissolved and cool.
Mix the juice and syrup in a jug, top with soda water and pour over ice.

s.note: the dinner party prawns grab the guests' faces
s.how: Poach 500g peeled green prawns for 2 minutes in salted water, then chill in iced water. Mix 120g mayonnaise, 2 tbsp tomato sauce, 1 tsp horseradish, a squeeze of lemon and a dash of hot sauce. Shred half an iceberg lettuce into four glasses, pile in the prawns and spoon the sauce over.

s.note: Adam's model of Winter River in the attic
s.how: Cut 120g cheddar, 120g gouda and 120g pepper jack into cubes and stack into tiny houses on a long board. Thread 250g cherry tomatoes and 100g cornichons onto toothpicks as trees between them, like Adam's model town.

m.how: Split 4 lobster tails lengthways. Mash 80g soft butter with 2 crushed garlic cloves, lemon zest and chopped parsley and brush over the flesh. Grill flesh side up for 6 minutes until just opaque. Fry 800g potatoes cut into shoestrings at 180C until crisp and serve with 100g salad leaves dressed in lemon.

w.note: black and white stripes, like the suit
w.how: Beat 200g butter and 200g sugar, add 4 eggs and fold in 250g self-raising flour with 80ml milk. Stir 2 tbsp cocoa into half the batter. Pipe alternating stripes into a loaf tin and bake at 170C for 50 minutes. Melt 150g white chocolate with 60ml cream and pour over, then pipe stripes with 50g melted dark chocolate.

d.how: Dissolve 60g caster sugar in 60ml hot water and cool. For four drinks, blend 180ml white rum, 80ml lime juice, 60ml syrup and 2 ripe bananas with 4 cups of ice until smooth. Pour into chilled glasses.
